setup.notice: This usually takes less than a minute.
setup.company_abbr_description: Used as a short prefix for your invoice numbers. Auto-filled from your company name — edit if you'd like something different.
setup.chart_of_accounts_description: A template for how your income and expenses get categorized. We've picked one for your country — you usually don't need to change this.
setup.fy_description: When your financial year starts. Most businesses use the default for their country — change this only if your accountant asks you to.
setup.minimal_description: We'll walk you through setting up your branch, tables, menu and user in a moment. (Recommended for first-time setup).
setup.advanced_description: Skip the walkthrough and configure everything yourself in the full admin panel.
setup.demo_hint: Loads sample data you can change later
setup.progress_subheading: This can take a few minutes if demo data is on.
setup.demo_with_data_description: Adds a sample branch, rooms, tables, menu, and POS you can change or delete later.

configure.branch_description: Set up your main branch name, invoice numbering, and tax details.
configure.rooms_description: Add the seating areas in your restaurant — you'll set how many tables each one has.
configure.tables_description: Review and adjust the tables we generated for each room — rename, adjust seats, or add more.
configure.menu_description: Add a few items to get started — you can bulk-import or add hundreds more anytime later.
configure.payment_description: How your customers will pay. Cash is added by default — add Card, UPI, or others your restaurant accepts.
configure.users_description: Add login accounts for your staff now, or skip this and add them later. We've suggested a starting cashier account below.
configure.data_can_be_changed: the data can be changed later

quickactions.heading: Quick Operations & Setup
quickactions.open_pos_description: Launch billing counter for active restaurant orders
quickactions.add_menu_description: Create new dishes, pricing, or course categories
quickactions.add_table_description: Configure new dining table layout & seat capacity
quickactions.add_room_description: Set up AC Hall, Terrace, VIP, or Bar dining sections
quickactions.add_user_description: Grant cashier, captain, or manager POS permissions
